subject: [AMBER] Warning in compilation: integer conversion resulted in change of sign

messages.author: Marcos Verissimo Alves
messages.body:
Dear all,
I'm compiling the latest version of Amber with GPU support, using CMake 3.24.3, GCCcore 11.3.0 and CUDA 12.0.0.
During the compilation, I'm getting lots of �integer conversion resulted in change of sign� errors, and I suppose this could be dangerous. Has anyone seen this warning while compiling, and how can I avoid it?
Best regards,
Marcos
